easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
